shows: The Wage Slave's apartment, 1F living room by day: the WP-P0-13 shell render (walls, floor, ladder to 2F, baked lightmap) at the game camera. No furniture yet.
why: The WP-P0-08 spike room is not built. Of the stills that exist, this one has the source's value range under the windows: Rec. 709 luma p50 59 / p90 93 / p99 114 against the eight source screenshots' p50 23-68 / p90 56-136, so the panels' translucency composites as it would in game. WP-P0-10's room_game_50.png (furniture on a grey void, p50 104) would make every panel read lighter than in the source.

derived.settings: RGB, 1920 x 1080 as rendered (no crop, no resize), JPEG quality 90, 4:4:4 chroma (subsampling 0), optimize

swap: Replace pages/ui-tile/backdrop.jpg with any 1920 x 1080 still (the WP-P0-08 spike still, from docs/art/spike/, once it exists) and update this file; nothing else refers to the image.
Or try one without replacing anything: pages/ui-tile.html?backdrop=<url> (also with &lang=zh and &view=kit).
Then re-run tests/e2e/ui-tile.spec.js: the contrast check measures every text run against the new still, and UI_TILE_OUT=docs/art/ui rewrites the screenshots and boards.
